caption: The plan screen inside the app, scrolled down: the feature list of the Basic plan (Smart AI Powered Upsell offers, Cart Page & Drawer offers, Custom Cross-selling, Custom "TRUE" Upsells, Funnel offers, Post Purchase offers, Subscription offers, Free Gift Offers), the button Get Started for Free, and vendor statements about results (200,000+ stores, 20-40% increase in average checkout order size, $20 million in extra revenue from upsells last month) that we did not test; the store name is hidden.

The Shopify Approve subscription screen for Bold Product Upsell, plan Basic: the yellow note You will not be billed for this test charge., $4,99 USD every 30 days, a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., a subtotal of $4,99 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $4,99 due 24 Nov, an Add payment method row (not filled in) and an Approve button; the store name is hidden.

The step Configure & Style of a new Upsell offer in the app: Offer Name Snowboard upgrade, Location Product Page (Only one location available), Trigger Products All products selected, Offer Products 1 product selected (The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard $2629.95), and the preview of a pop-up Want to upgrade? with the text that accepting replaces the original item in the cart, the button Replace item and a No thanks link; this is the preview inside the app, not the store page; the store name is hidden.

The Manual Offers page after saving, with the toast Offer created successfully., the banner App Embed Status: Inactive with Action required to display upsells on your storefront, and one row Snowboard upgrade, Upsell, Product Page Pop-up, Views 0, Conversions 0, Revenue $0.00, Active; the store name is hidden.
